products.name: Cerebras
products.note: Wafer-scale AI compute; inference API; on-prem options; high-performance computing

profile_text.body:
Cerebras is an AI infrastructure company that describes itself as a platform for AI training and inference, built around its proprietary wafer-scale chip technology. The company's flagship hardware product is the CS-4, which it describes as a rack-scale solution delivering up to 30x faster inference compared to GPUs and positioned as infrastructure for frontier AI at hyperscale. Cerebras also offers an inference API and on-premises deployment options alongside its hardware.

The company counts several notable organizations among its partners and customers, including OpenAI, GSK, Notion, and LiveKit. OpenAI describes Cerebras as providing a dedicated low-latency inference solution within its compute portfolio. GSK has noted using Cerebras infrastructure to develop AI applications for drug discovery, including cancer-drug response prediction models reported to run many hundreds of times faster on Cerebras hardware than on conventional GPUs. Notion cites the platform as powering real-time features such as enterprise search.

The site's held facts list Cerebras under the Chat and General LLMs category, noting wafer-scale AI compute, an inference API, on-premises options, and high-performance computing as its core offerings. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
